attack_techniques: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder (T1547.001)
attackers_goals: Gain persistence on the host using the Window's autostart Mechanism.
description: Microsoft Office adds a value to a registry entry (run keys, startup folders) to establish persistence.
investigative_actions: Check the registry key and determine what process it'll run. Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Microsoft Office adds a value to autostart Registry key
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
